scope: Same-engine-cycle BUY/SELL quote-coordinate and fill-mid identity audit. No model fitting, strategy arm, PnL promotion, Validation, holdout, action, or live authority.

contracts.decision_pairing: strict adjacent BUY then SELL writes with identical mid and inventory state
contracts.primary_quote_denominator: flat inventory and both sides allow_post plus allow_exposure_increase
contracts.entry_edge_authority: opener fills with exact lifecycle identity and finite order age only
contracts.missing_lifecycle_behavior: report and exclude; never backfill a different mid identity
contracts.future_markout_sensitivity: lifecycle-valid rows with observation delay at most 10 seconds
contracts.markout_ema_semantics: maker-signed positive is favorable for both BUY and SELL

observed_runtime_inputs.observed_sign_source: remote runtime config-code default because YAML omitted the field
